name: Ground Turkey Stuffed Peppers
ingredients_verbatim: Salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese, divided
why: Oven-baked turkey stuffed peppers, published 411 cal / 38g protein / 25g carbs per serving - clears the 400-650 cal and <=35g carb band with a very high protein-to-calorie ratio. Maps cleanly to the board (bell-peppers, ground-turkey, onions, garlic, diced-tomatoes, rice for the wild-rice blend, shredded-cheese, olive-oil). Not a catalog duplicate: existing turkey stuffed pepper entry is a SOUP and the only stuffed-pepper bake is beef Philly. Confidence: moderate - published cal (411) sits near the floor, so label-accurate recompute could dip under 400; carbs have comfortable headroom.
